fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects changes to the registry key "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\Userlist" where the value is set to "0" in order to hide user account from being listed on the logon screen.
fields.name: Hiding User Account Via SpecialAccounts Registry Key - CommandLine
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\reg.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\SpecialAccounts\\UserList" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "add" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/v" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/d 0")))
